pattern: を前提として（をぜんていとして）
purpose: Make an agreement or action rest on an explicit prerequisite.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
N + を前提として; clause + ことを前提として
I included you in the count on the assumption that you would attend.
I will lend it on condition that you return it.
The plan rests on ensuring safety.
formation: N + を前提として; clause + ことを前提として
restrictions: The prerequisite is assumed or required for what follows.
mistake: If the prerequisite fails, the arrangement may no longer apply.
